import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountApplicationSearch } from '../templates/search/applications/mount.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const result = await mountApplicationSearch(
		element,
		{ i18n, inheritAppearance: true },
		onError
	);
	return result;
}

<template>
	<div class="card-geometry-controls" data-card-geometry>
		<label
			>{{ t('layout') }}
			<AsamSelect
				:model-value="modelValue.layout"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:size="size"
				@update:model-value="setLayout"
				><AsamOption value="grid" :label="t('grid')" /><AsamOption
					value="masonry"
					:label="t('masonry')" /></AsamSelect></label
		><label
			>{{ t('cardSize') }}
			<AsamSelect
				:model-value="preset"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:size="size"
				@update:model-value="setPreset"
				><AsamOption
					v-for="item in presets"
					:key="item"
					:value="item"
					:label="t(item)" /></AsamSelect></label
		><label v-if="preset === 'custom'"
			>{{ t('minWidth') }}
			<AsamInputNumber
				:model-value="customMinWidth"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:size="size"
				:min="1"
				@update:model-value="setMinWidth" /></label
		><label
			>{{ t('columns') }}
			<AsamInputNumber
				:model-value="modelValue.columns === 'auto' ? undefined : modelValue.columns"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:size="size"
				:min="1"
				:precision="0"
				:placeholder="t('auto')"
				@update:model-value="setColumns" /></label
		><label
			>{{ t('maxWidth') }}
			<AsamInputNumber
				:model-value="modelValue.maxWidth"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:size="size"
				:min="1"
				:placeholder="t('unlimited')"
				@update:model-value="setMaxWidth"
		/></label>
	</div>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardPreset, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type { CardPresentation } from './Presentation.js';
import { cardGeometryMessages } from './messages.js';
import type { CardGeometryLabel } from './messages.js';

const props = defineProps<{
	modelValue: CardPresentation;
	disabled?: boolean;
	size?: AsamControlSize;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [value: CardPresentation] }>();
const i18n = useAsamProI18n(cardGeometryMessages);
const t = (name: CardGeometryLabel) => i18n.t(`app.templates.cards.${name}`);
const presets = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large', 'custom'] as const;
const preset = computed(() =>
	typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? 'custom' : props.modelValue.cardSize
);
const customMinWidth = computed(() =>
	typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? props.modelValue.cardSize.minWidth : 240
);
function update(value: Partial<CardPresentation>) {
	if (!props.disabled) emit('update:modelValue', { ...props.modelValue, ...value });
}
function setLayout(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'grid' || value === 'masonry') update({ layout: value });
}
function setPreset(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'custom')
		update({
			cardSize: {
				minWidth: 260,
				padding: 20,
				titleFontSize: 18,
				bodyFontSize: 14,
				contentGap: 12
			}
		});
	else if (presets.some((item) => item === value)) update({ cardSize: value as AsamCardPreset });
}
function setMinWidth(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0)
		update({
			cardSize: {
				...(typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? props.modelValue.cardSize : {}),
				minWidth: value
			}
		});
}
function setColumns(value: unknown) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) update({ columns: 'auto' });
	else if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0)
		update({ columns: value });
}
function setMaxWidth(value: unknown) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) update({ maxWidth: undefined });
	else if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0)
		update({ maxWidth: value });
}
</script>

import type { AsamCardLayout, AsamCardSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';

/** 模板展示配置；仅透传公开几何属性，不保存业务数据或控件 size。 */
export interface CardPresentation {
	readonly layout: AsamCardLayout;
	readonly cardSize: AsamCardSize;
	readonly columns: 'auto' | number;
	readonly maxWidth?: number;
}

export const createCardPresentation = (cardSize: AsamCardSize = 'default'): CardPresentation => ({
	layout: 'grid',
	cardSize,
	columns: 'auto'
});

const en = {
	layout: 'Layout',
	grid: 'Grid',
	masonry: 'Masonry',
	cardSize: 'Card density',
	small: 'Small',
	default: 'Default',
	big: 'Big',
	large: 'Large',
	custom: 'Custom',
	minWidth: 'Minimum width',
	columns: 'Columns',
	auto: 'Auto',
	maxWidth: 'Maximum width',
	unlimited: 'Unlimited'
};
const zh = {
	layout: '布局',
	grid: '网格',
	masonry: '瀑布流',
	cardSize: '卡片密度',
	small: '紧凑',
	default: '默认',
	big: '宽松',
	large: '大卡片',
	custom: '自定义',
	minWidth: '最小宽度',
	columns: '列数',
	auto: '自动',
	maxWidth: '最大宽度',
	unlimited: '不限制'
};
export type CardGeometryLabel = keyof typeof en;
type CardGeometryParameters = {
	[K in CardGeometryLabel as `app.templates.cards.${K}`]: Record<never, never>;
};
declare module '@asam-ui/ui/i18n' {
	interface AsamI18nMessageParameters extends CardGeometryParameters {}
}
const prefix = (values: typeof en) =>
	Object.fromEntries(
		Object.entries(values).map(([key, value]) => ['app.templates.cards.' + key, value])
	) as { [K in keyof CardGeometryParameters]: string };
export const cardGeometryMessages = { en: prefix(en), 'zh-CN': prefix(zh) };

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamListContent } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord } from './Types.js';

export function displayValue(value: unknown, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	return value === undefined
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.notProvided')
			: '未提供'
		: value === null
			? scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.search.unknown')
				: '未知'
			: value === false
				? scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.search.no')
					: '否'
				: value === true
					? scope?.enabled.value
						? scope.t('app.templates.search.yes')
						: '是'
					: String(value);
}
export function displayDate(value: string | null | undefined, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) return displayValue(value, scope);
	return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) &&
		Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) &&
		new Date(value).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(scope.locale.value, {
					year: 'numeric',
					month: '2-digit',
					day: '2-digit',
					timeZone: 'UTC'
				}).format(new Date(value))
			: value
		: scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.invalidDate')
			: '日期无效';
}
export function displayProgress(value: number | null | undefined, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 100
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? new Intl.NumberFormat(scope.locale.value, {
					style: 'percent',
					maximumFractionDigits: 20
				}).format(value / 100)
			: `${value}%`
		: scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.unknownProgress')
			: '进度未知';
}
/** 纯映射；从不写入行、读取权限、发起请求或改变导航。 */
export function searchContent(row: SearchRecord, scope?: AsamI18n): AsamListContent {
	const meta = [
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.category') : '类别',
			value: displayValue(row.category, scope)
		},
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.status') : '状态',
			value: displayValue(row.status, scope)
		},
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.owner') : '负责人',
			value: displayValue(row.owner, scope)
		}
	];
	if (row.kind === 'basic')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.reference') : '编号',
				value: row.reference
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.updated') : '更新',
				value: displayDate(row.updatedAt, scope)
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'cards')
		meta.push({
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.collection') : '合集',
			value: row.collection
		});
	if (row.kind === 'articles')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.author') : '作者',
				value: row.author
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.published') : '发布',
				value: displayDate(row.publishedAt, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.tags') : '标签',
				value:
					row.tags.join(' · ') ||
					(scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.noTags') : '无标签')
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'projects')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.stage') : '阶段',
				value: displayValue(row.stage, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.progress') : '进度',
				value: displayProgress(row.progress, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.start') : '开始',
				value: displayDate(row.startDate, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.end') : '结束',
				value: displayDate(row.endDate, scope)
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'applications')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.version') : '版本',
				value: displayValue(row.version, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.platforms') : '平台',
				value:
					row.platforms.join(' / ') ||
					(scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.notProvided') : '未提供')
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.available') : '可用',
				value: displayValue(row.available, scope)
			}
		);
	return {
		title: row.title,
		description: row.description,
		meta,
		...(row.kind === 'cards' ? { cover: row.cover } : {}),
		...(row.kind === 'projects'
			? {
					avatars: row.members.map((member, index) => ({
						id: `${index}`,
						name: member.name,
						src: member.avatar
					}))
				}
			: {})
	};
}
ts
import { computed } from 'vue';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListActionResult,
	AsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord, SearchSession } from './Types.js';

type QueryAction = AsamListController<SearchRecord>['submit'];

export function createSearchQueryController(
	session: SearchSession,
	view: {
		fields: () => readonly AsamFieldDefinition[];
		encode?: (draft: AsamFieldModel) => AsamFieldModel;
		decode?: (draft: AsamFieldModel) => AsamFieldModel;
		reset?: QueryAction;
		beforeRead?: () => void;
	}
): AsamListController<SearchRecord> {
	const controller = session.controller;
	const ready = computed(
		() =>
			!session.access().disabled && session.access().permitted && controller.scopeReady.value
	);
	function guarded(action: QueryAction): QueryAction {
		return async (validate) => {
			if (!ready.value) return { status: 'blocked' };
			let result: AsamListActionResult = { status: 'blocked' };
			const current = await session.read(async () => {
				view.beforeRead?.();
				result = await action(validate);
			});
			return current ? result : { status: 'cancelled' };
		};
	}
	return {
		...controller,
		fields: computed(view.fields),
		draft: computed(() => view.encode?.(controller.draft.value) ?? controller.draft.value),
		scopeReady: ready,
		setDraft(draft) {
			if (ready.value) controller.setDraft(view.decode?.(draft) ?? draft);
		},
		submit: guarded(controller.submit),
		reset: guarded(view.reset ?? controller.reset)
	};
}

export function keywordQueryField(
	label: string,
	name: string,
	placeholder?: string
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key: 'keyword',
		kind: 'text',
		label,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { name, placeholder, clearable: true } } }
	};
}
ts
import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamListRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchKind, SearchRecord, SearchService } from './Types.js';
import { encodeRowKey } from './Types.js';

const categories = ['设计', '工程', 0, '0', null] as const;
const statuses = ['已就绪', '进行中', false, null] as const;
const owners = ['林岚', '周远', 0, '0', null, undefined] as const;
export const localGraphic = `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="280" viewBox="0 0 600 280"><rect width="600" height="280" fill="#dde8e3"/><path d="M40 240L210 40 380 240ZM260 240L430 40 570 240Z" fill="none" stroke="#46675a" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="300" cy="140" r="62" fill="#a4c3b4"/></svg>')}`;
/** 合成数据固定100条；0与'0'拥有独立typed身份。 */
export function createSearchRecords(kind: SearchKind): SearchRecord[] {
	return Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, index): SearchRecord => {
		const base = {
			id: index === 1 ? '0' : index === 0 ? 0 : index,
			title:
				index === 6
					? '跨团队协作中的设计约束、工程记录与长期内容整理方法'.repeat(3)
					: `${['山海知识', '城市观察', '协作档案', '开放研究'][index % 4]} · ${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
			description:
				index === 6
					? '长内容用于检验窄屏换行与完整阅读。'.repeat(9)
					: '记录设计、工程与协作中的具体方法，提供可追溯的本地演示内容。',
			category: categories[index % categories.length],
			status: statuses[index % statuses.length],
			owner: owners[index % owners.length]
		};
		switch (kind) {
			case 'basic':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					reference: `REF-${index + 1}`,
					updatedAt: index % 3 ? '2026-10-12' : undefined
				};
			case 'cards':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					cover: {
						src: index === 3 ? './missing-cover.svg' : localGraphic,
						alt: `山海几何构图 ${index + 1}`
					},
					collection: index % 2 ? '空间研究' : '日常设计'
				};
			case 'articles':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					author: index % 2 ? '陈澄' : '许知',
					publishedAt: index % 3 ? '2026-10-10' : null,
					tags: ['设计方法', index % 2 ? '案例' : '实践'],
					body: [
						'从一个具体问题开始，记录观察、约束与取舍。',
						'示例正文仅为本地合成文本。<script>不会执行</script>',
						base.description
					]
				};
			case 'projects':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					stage: index % 4 ? '宿主阶段：研究验证' : undefined,
					progress: index % 4 ? (index * 7) % 101 : NaN,
					startDate: '2026-09-01',
					endDate: index % 3 ? '2026-12-01' : null,
					members: [
						{ name: '林岚', avatar: index === 2 ? './missing-avatar.svg' : undefined },
						{ name: '周远' }
					]
				};
			case 'applications':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					icon: localGraphic,
					version: index % 3 ? '2.1.0' : null,
					platforms: ['Web', '桌面浏览器'],
					available: index % 3 ? true : false,
					route: 'local-demo'
				};
		}
	});
}
export function querySearchRecords(
	rows: readonly SearchRecord[],
	request: AsamListRequest
): { list: SearchRecord[]; total: number } {
	const q = request.query;
	const keyword = typeof q.keyword === 'string' ? q.keyword.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() : '';
	const filtered = rows.filter(
		(row) =>
			(!keyword ||
				`${row.title} ${row.description} ${row.kind === 'articles' ? row.body.join(' ') : ''}`
					.toLocaleLowerCase()
					.includes(keyword)) &&
			['category', 'status', 'owner'].every(
				(key) =>
					q[key] === undefined ||
					Object.is(
						key === 'status' && row.kind === 'applications'
							? row.available
							: Reflect.get(row, key),
						q[key]
					)
			)
	);
	if (request.sort) {
		const { field, order } = request.sort;
		if (!['title', 'id'].includes(field))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				new TypeError('未允许的排序字段'),
				'app.templates.search.invalidSort'
			);
		filtered.sort(
			(a, b) =>
				String(Reflect.get(a, field)).localeCompare(
					String(Reflect.get(b, field)),
					'zh-CN',
					{ numeric: true }
				) * (order === 'ascending' ? 1 : -1) ||
				encodeRowKey(a.id).localeCompare(encodeRowKey(b.id))
		);
	}
	return {
		list: filtered.slice(
			(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
			request.currentPage * request.pageSize
		),
		total: filtered.length
	};
}
/** 这是可替换的合成读取适配，查询/排序作用于全部100条。 */
export function createSearchService(
	kind: SearchKind
): SearchService & { failNext(): void; readonly calls: number } {
	const rows = createSearchRecords(kind);
	let fail = false,
		calls = 0;
	return {
		get calls() {
			return calls;
		},
		failNext() {
			fail = true;
		},
		async read(request, context) {
			calls++;
			const shouldFail = fail;
			fail = false;
			await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(new DOMException('读取取消', 'AbortError'));
				};
				const timer = setTimeout(() => {
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				}, 100);
				if (context.signal.aborted) abort();
				else context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
			});
			if (shouldFail)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'合成读取失败，请重试',
					'app.templates.search.readFailed'
				);
			return querySearchRecords(rows, request);
		}
	};
}

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import { effectScope, toValue } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamListController,
	AsamListRequest
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord, SearchSession, SearchSessionOptions } from './Types.js';
import { emptyConditions } from './Types.js';
import { searchContent } from './Content.js';

export const searchFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{ key: 'keyword', label: '关键词', kind: 'text', defaultValue: () => '' },
	...['category', 'status', 'owner'].map((key) => ({
		key,
		label: { category: '类别', status: '状态', owner: '负责人' }[key] ?? key,
		kind: 'single' as const,
		query: (value: unknown) => value
	}))
];
/** 自有effect scope只释放本会话创建的controller；借入runtime/controller从不dispose。 */
export function createSearchSession(options: SearchSessionOptions): SearchSession {
	if (options.controller && !options.runtime)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('借入controller必须显式提供其宿主runtime'),
			'app.templates.search.borrowRuntime'
		);
	const scope = effectScope(true);
	const runtime =
		options.runtime ??
		createAsamDataRuntime({
			scope: `search:${options.kind}:${toValue(options.access).identity}`
		});
	let alive = true;
	const access = () => toValue(options.access);
	const guard = () =>
		JSON.stringify([
			runtime.scope,
			runtime.epoch,
			access().identity,
			access().version,
			access().disabled,
			access().permitted
		]);
	const current = (token: string) =>
		alive && !access().disabled && access().permitted && token === guard();
	const accumulatesPages = !!options.accumulatePages && !options.controller;
	const prefixes = new Map<number, readonly SearchRecord[]>();
	const queryKey = (query: AsamListRequest) =>
		JSON.stringify([query.query, query.sort, query.pageSize]);
	const controller: AsamListController<SearchRecord> =
		options.controller ??
		scope.run(() =>
			useAsamListController<SearchRecord>({
				fields: searchFields,
				initial: { ...emptyConditions },
				pageSize: 20,
				immediate: false,
				rowKey: (row) => row.id,
				runtime,
				api: async (request, context) => {
					const token = guard();
					if (!current(token))
						throw createAsamMessageError(
							'当前身份、权限或禁用状态不允许读取',
							'app.templates.search.readDenied'
						);
					let prefix: readonly SearchRecord[] = [];
					if (accumulatesPages) {
						const previous = controller.successfulSource.value;
						if (request.currentPage === 1) prefixes.clear();
						else if (
							previous?.epoch === runtime.epoch &&
							queryKey(previous) === queryKey(request)
						) {
							if (previous.currentPage + 1 === request.currentPage) {
								prefix = controller.page.data.value.list;
								prefixes.set(request.currentPage, prefix);
							} else if (previous.currentPage >= request.currentPage) {
								prefix = prefixes.get(request.currentPage) ?? [];
							}
						}
					}
					const result = await options.service.read(request, context);
					context.signal.throwIfAborted();
					if (!current(token)) throw new DOMException('读取上下文已失效', 'AbortError');
					if (!accumulatesPages || !result.total) return result;
					const records = new Map(
						[...prefix, ...result.list].map((row) => [row.id, row])
					);
					return {
						list: [...records.values()].slice(0, result.total),
						total: result.total
					};
				}
			})
		)!;
	return {
		kind: options.kind,
		accumulatesPages,
		controller,
		runtime,
		content: searchContent,
		access,
		guard,
		current,
		async read(operation) {
			const token = guard();
			if (!current(token)) return false;
			await operation();
			return current(token);
		},
		dispose() {
			if (!alive) return;
			alive = false;
			scope.stop();
		}
	};
}

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamRowKey, AsamControlSize, AsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamListController,
	AsamListRequest,
	AsamListContent,
	AsamListAction
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { MaybeRefOrGetter } from 'vue';

export type SearchKind = 'basic' | 'cards' | 'articles' | 'projects' | 'applications';
export type SearchFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'technology';
export interface SearchBase {
	readonly id: AsamRowKey;
	readonly kind: SearchKind;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly description: string;
	readonly category: string | number | null;
	readonly status: string | boolean | null;
	readonly owner?: string | number | null;
}
export interface BasicRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'basic';
	readonly updatedAt?: string | null;
	readonly reference: string;
}
export interface CardRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'cards';
	readonly updatedAt?: string;
	readonly cover: { readonly src: string; readonly alt: string };
	readonly collection: string;
}
export interface ArticleRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'articles';
	readonly author: string;
	readonly publishedAt?: string | null;
	readonly tags: readonly string[];
	readonly body: readonly string[];
}
export interface ProjectRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'projects';
	readonly stage?: string | null;
	readonly progress?: number | null;
	readonly startDate?: string | null;
	readonly endDate?: string | null;
	readonly members: readonly { readonly name: string; readonly avatar?: string }[];
}
export interface ApplicationRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'applications';
	readonly icon: string;
	readonly version?: string | null;
	readonly platforms: readonly string[];
	/** 应用可用性；null表示未知，与通用行status独立。P14的status查询映射此字段。 */
	readonly available: boolean | null;
	readonly route: 'local-demo';
}
export type SearchRecord =
	BasicRecord | CardRecord | ArticleRecord | ProjectRecord | ApplicationRecord;
export interface SearchConditions {
	readonly keyword: string;
	readonly category: string | number | null | undefined;
	/** P14映射available：true可用、false不可用、null未知、undefined不限；其他页映射行status。 */
	readonly status: string | boolean | null | undefined;
	readonly owner: string | number | null | undefined;
}
export interface SearchService {
	read(
		request: AsamListRequest,
		context: { readonly signal: AbortSignal }
	): Promise<{ list: SearchRecord[]; total: number }>;
}
export interface SearchAccess {
	readonly identity: string;
	readonly version: string;
	readonly disabled: boolean;
	readonly readonly: boolean;
	readonly permitted: boolean;
}
export interface SearchSessionOptions {
	readonly kind: SearchKind;
	readonly service: SearchService;
	readonly access: MaybeRefOrGetter<SearchAccess>;
	readonly runtime?: AsamDataRuntime;
	readonly controller?: AsamListController<SearchRecord>;
	/** 读取下一批结果时保留已成功返回的前序页面。 */
	readonly accumulatePages?: boolean;
}
export interface SearchPageProps {
	readonly session: SearchSession;
	readonly size?: AsamControlSize;
	/** 宿主返回真实导航结果；事件仅在成功后通知，不作为异步操作回执。 */
	readonly navigatePreview: (row: SearchRecord) => Promise<boolean>;
	/** 独立页面可组合原操作；省略时沿用原只读预览入口。 */
	readonly rowActions?: readonly AsamListAction<SearchRecord>[];
}
export interface SearchSession {
	readonly kind: SearchKind;
	readonly accumulatesPages?: boolean;
	readonly controller: AsamListController<SearchRecord>;
	readonly runtime: AsamDataRuntime;
	readonly content: (row: SearchRecord) => AsamListContent;
	access(): SearchAccess;
	guard(): string;
	current(token: string): boolean;
	read(operation: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<boolean>;
	dispose(): void;
}
export const searchKinds: readonly SearchKind[] = [
	'basic',
	'cards',
	'articles',
	'projects',
	'applications'
];
export const searchTitles: Readonly<Record<SearchKind, string>> = {
	basic: '资料列表',
	cards: '灵感卡片',
	articles: '文章搜索',
	projects: '项目搜索',
	applications: '应用搜索'
};
export const emptyConditions: SearchConditions = {
	keyword: '',
	category: undefined,
	status: undefined,
	owner: undefined
};
export function encodeRowKey(key: AsamRowKey): string {
	return `${typeof key}:${String(key)}`;
}

export function displaySearchTitle(kind: SearchKind, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	const keys = {
		basic: 'app.templates.search.titleBasic',
		cards: 'app.templates.search.titleCards',
		articles: 'app.templates.search.titleArticles',
		projects: 'app.templates.search.titleProjects',
		applications: 'app.templates.search.titleApplications'
	} as const;
	return scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t(keys[kind]) : searchTitles[kind];
}

</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamAlert, AsamButton, AsamConfigProvider, AsamOption, AsamSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './Models.js';
import type { ApplicationFixture, ApplicationSaveMode } from './Fixture.js';
import { applicationSaveModes } from './Fixture.js';
import { useApplicationText } from './I18n.js';
import ApplicationPage from './ApplicationPage.vue';
const props = defineProps<{
	fixture: ApplicationFixture;
	externalI18n?: AsamI18n;
	inheritAppearance?: boolean;
	onLocale?: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => void;
}>();
const { i18n, t } = useApplicationText();
const theme = shallowRef<'light' | 'dark'>('light'),
	size = shallowRef<AsamFlowSize>('default');
const sizes = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'] as const;
function setLocale(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'zh-CN' || value === 'en') props.onLocale?.(value);
}
function setTheme(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark') theme.value = value;
}
function setSize(value: unknown) {
	if (sizes.includes(value as AsamFlowSize)) size.value = value as AsamFlowSize;
}
function setMode(value: unknown) {
	if (applicationSaveModes.includes(value as ApplicationSaveMode))
		props.fixture.setSaveMode(value as ApplicationSaveMode);
}
onBeforeUnmount(props.fixture.dispose);
</script>

<template>

							>{{

					</div>
					<p class="application-updated">
						{{ t('updated') }} ·

				</div></template
			><template #operation="{ row }"
				><AsamButton

					text

				><AsamButton
					type="primary"
					plain
					:disabled="actionsBlocked || host.session.access().readonly"
					@click="host.workflow.edit(row)"
					>{{ t('edit') }}</AsamButton

			><template #empty><AsamEmpty :description="t('empty')" /></template></AsamProList
		><RecordOverlays
			:workflow="host.workflow"
			:edit-title="t('editTitle')"

			:edit-label="t('edit')"
			:close-label="t('close')"
			:field-labels="fieldLabels"
			:size="size"
		/>
	</main>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

import ListToolbar from '../../shared/ListToolbar.vue';
import '../../shared/ListSurfaces.css';
import { useSearchListTools } from '../shared/ListTools.js';
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamAlert,
	AsamAvatar,
	AsamButton,
	AsamCheckTag,
	AsamEmpty,
	AsamOption,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamTag
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamProList, AsamSearchForm } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamListContent } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { SearchRecord } from '../Types.js';
import type { ApplicationHost } from './Types.js';
import type { ApplicationLabel } from './I18n.js';
import { useApplicationText } from './I18n.js';
import { applicationCount } from './Metrics.js';
import { emptyConditions } from '../Types.js';
import { displayDate, displayValue } from '../Content.js';
import GeometryControls from '../../cards/GeometryControls.vue';
import type { CardPresentation } from '../../cards/Presentation.js';
import { createSearchQueryController, keywordQueryField } from '../QueryController.js';
import RecordOverlays from '../shared/RecordOverlays.vue';
const props = defineProps<{ host: ApplicationHost; size?: AsamControlSize }>();
const { i18n, t } = useApplicationText();
const c = props.host.session.controller;
const presentation = shallowRef<CardPresentation>({
	layout: 'grid',
	cardSize: { minWidth: 220 },
	columns: 'auto',
	maxWidth: 360
});
const blocked = computed(
	() => props.host.session.access().disabled || !props.host.session.access().permitted
);
const actionsBlocked = computed(() => blocked.value || !c.resultReady.value);
const queryController = createSearchQueryController(props.host.session, {
	fields: () => [keywordQueryField(t('keyword'), 'application-keyword', t('placeholder'))]
});
const availability = computed(() =>
	c.draft.value.status === true
		? 'available'
		: c.draft.value.status === false
			? 'unavailable'
			: c.draft.value.status === null
				? 'unknown'
				: 'all'
);
const categories: readonly { label: ApplicationLabel; value: string | undefined }[] = [
	{ label: 'all', value: undefined },
	{ label: 'design', value: '设计' },
	{ label: 'engineering', value: '工程' }
];
const wide = shallowRef(false);
const layout = computed({
	get: () => presentation.value.layout,
	set(value: CardPresentation['layout']) {
		presentation.value = { ...presentation.value, layout: value };
	}
});
const { tools, run: runTool } = useSearchListTools(
	props.host.session,
	(key) => t(key),
	() => i18n.t('pro.table.editing.refresh')
);
const fieldLabels = computed(() => ({
	title: t('fieldTitle'),
	description: t('description'),
	owner: t('owner'),
	version: t('version'),
	platforms: t('platforms')
}));
const content = (row: SearchRecord): AsamListContent => ({
	title: row.title,
	description: row.description
});
const count = (value: unknown) => applicationCount(value, i18n.locale.value, t('unknown'));
async function search() {
	if (!blocked.value) await props.host.session.read(() => c.submit());
}
async function setCategory(value: string | undefined) {
	if (blocked.value) return;
	c.setDraft({ ...c.draft.value, category: value });
	await search();
}
async function setAvailability(value: unknown) {
	if (
		blocked.value ||
		typeof value !== 'string' ||
		!['all', 'available', 'unavailable', 'unknown'].includes(value)
	)
		return;
	c.setDraft({
		...c.draft.value,
		status:
			value === 'available'
				? true
				: value === 'unavailable'
					? false
					: value === 'unknown'
						? null
						: undefined
	});
	await search();
}
async function resume() {
	if (blocked.value) return;
	c.resumeScope({ ...emptyConditions });
	await search();
}
</script>

import { effectScope, reactive, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createAsamWriteCoordinator } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition, AsamFieldModel, AsamSaveResult } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamRowKey } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { applicationMessages } from './I18n.js';
import { createSearchSession } from '../Session.js';
import { createSearchRecords, querySearchRecords } from '../Service.js';
import { emptyConditions } from '../Types.js';
import type {
	ApplicationRecord,
	SearchAccess,
	SearchRecord,
	SearchService,
	SearchSession
} from '../Types.js';
import { useRecordWorkflow } from '../shared/RecordWorkflow.js';
import type { ApplicationLabel } from './I18n.js';
import type { ApplicationHost, ApplicationPresentation } from './Types.js';

export const applicationSaveModes = ['success', 'failure', 'unknown-applied'] as const;
export type ApplicationSaveMode = (typeof applicationSaveModes)[number];
type MutableAccess = { -readonly [K in keyof SearchAccess]: SearchAccess[K] };

/** Explicit local demo records and metrics, adapted into the original controllers. */
export function createApplicationFixture(i18n: AsamI18n) {
	const scope = effectScope(true);
	const textScope = extendAsamI18n(i18n, applicationMessages);
	const access = reactive<MutableAccess>({
		identity: 'application-reader-a',
		version: '1',
		disabled: false,
		readonly: false,
		permitted: true
	});
	const controls = reactive({ save: 'success' as ApplicationSaveMode, failNext: false });
	const saved = shallowRef(false);
	const audit = { reads: 0, saves: 0, commits: 0, verifies: 0 };
	const seed = createSearchRecords('applications')
		.filter((row): row is ApplicationRecord => row.kind === 'applications')
		.slice(0, 25)
		.map((row, index) => ({
			...row,
			available: index === 0 ? null : index === 1 ? false : row.available,
			icon: index === 2 ? 'data:image/png;base64,AAAA' : row.icon
		}));
	const stores = new Map<string, Map<AsamRowKey, ApplicationRecord>>();
	const operations = new Map<string, { id: AsamRowKey; result: AsamSaveResult }>();
	const seedDisplay = new Map<AsamRowKey, ApplicationPresentation>(
		seed.map((row, index) => [
			row.id,
			{
				activeUsers: index === 0 ? 0 : index === 1 ? null : 1280 + index * 37,
				weeklyNew: index === 0 ? 0 : index === 1 ? null : 20 + index * 3,
				updatedAt: index === 0 ? null : '2026-10-30'
			}
		])
	);
	const displayStores = new Map<string, Map<AsamRowKey, ApplicationPresentation>>();
	const text = (key: ApplicationLabel) =>
		textScope.t(...([`app.templates.applicationSearch.${key}`] as Parameters<AsamI18n['t']>));
	function store(owner: string) {
		let value = stores.get(owner);
		if (!value) {
			value = new Map(seed.map((row) => [row.id, { ...row, platforms: [...row.platforms] }]));
			stores.set(owner, value);
		}
		return value;
	}
	function displayRows(owner: string) {
		let value = displayStores.get(owner);
		if (!value) {
			value = new Map(seedDisplay);
			displayStores.set(owner, value);
		}
		return value;
	}
	async function wait(signal: AbortSignal) {
		await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
			const abort = () => {
				clearTimeout(timer);
				signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
				reject(new DOMException('Read cancelled', 'AbortError'));
			};
			const timer = setTimeout(() => {
				signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
				resolve();
			}, 80);
			if (signal.aborted) abort();
			else signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		});
	}
	function model(row: ApplicationRecord): AsamFieldModel {
		return {
			title: row.title,
			description: row.description,
			owner: String(row.owner ?? ''),
			version: row.version ?? '',
			platforms: row.platforms.join('\n')
		};
	}
	const fields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
		{ key: 'title', label: '应用标题', kind: 'text' },
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', kind: 'text' },
		{ key: 'description', label: '摘要', kind: 'textarea' },
		{ key: 'version', label: '版本', kind: 'text' },
		{ key: 'platforms', label: '平台（每行一个）', kind: 'textarea' }
	];
	let session: SearchSession;
	const service: SearchService = {
		async read(request, context) {
			audit.reads++;
			const owner = session.runtime.scope;
			await wait(context.signal);
			if (controls.failNext) {
				controls.failNext = false;
				throw new Error(text('readError'));
			}
			return querySearchRecords([...store(owner).values()], request);
		}
	};
	const owned = scope.run(() => {
		session = createSearchSession({ kind: 'applications', service, access: () => access });
		const allowed = (action: 'detail' | 'edit', row: SearchRecord) =>
			row.kind === 'applications' &&
			session.current(session.guard()) &&
			session.controller.resultReady.value &&
			(action === 'detail' || !access.readonly);
		const writes = createAsamWriteCoordinator();
		const operationIds = new Map<string, string>();
		let sequence = 0;
		const workflow = useRecordWorkflow<SearchRecord>({
			runtime: session.runtime,
			fields,
			key: (row) => row.id,
			resolve: (key) => session.controller.page.data.value.list.find((row) => row.id === key),
			context: () =>
				JSON.stringify([
					session.guard(),
					session.controller.intent.value?.query,
					session.controller.intent.value?.sort
				]),
			allowed,
			detail: (row) => ({
				mode: 'load',
				id: row.id,
				load: async (id, context) => {
					await wait(context.signal);
					const current = store(context.scope).get(id);
					return current
						? { status: 'ready', data: model(current) }
						: { status: 'missing' };
				}
			}),
			operationId: (row) => {
				saved.value = false;
				const key = JSON.stringify([session.runtime.scope, typeof row.id, row.id]);
				const previous = operationIds.get(key);
				const status = previous
					? writes.get(session.runtime.scope, previous)?.status
					: undefined;
				if (previous && (status === 'saving' || status === 'unknown')) return previous;
				const next = `application-edit-${++sequence}`;
				operationIds.set(key, next);
				return next;
			},
			editor: {
				coordinator: writes,
				load: async (target, context) => {
					await wait(context.signal);
					const row =
						target.id === undefined ? undefined : store(context.scope).get(target.id);
					if (!row) throw new Error('Application missing');
					return model(row);
				},
				validatePayload: async (value) =>
					typeof value.title === 'string' && value.title.trim()
						? []
						: [{ key: 'title', message: text('required') }],
				formatError: (cause) => {
					if (cause && typeof cause === 'object' && 'status' in cause) {
						if (cause.status === 'unknown') return text('saveUnknown');
						if (cause.status === 'failure') return text('saveDenied');
					}
					return text('operationError');
				},
				async save(value, operation, context) {
					audit.saves++;
					const mode = controls.save;
					const key = JSON.stringify([operation.scope, operation.target.operationId]);
					const prior = operations.get(key);
					if (prior) return prior.result;
					await wait(context.signal);
					if (mode === 'failure')
						return { status: 'failure', message: text('saveDenied') };
					const current =
						operation.target.id === undefined
							? undefined
							: store(context.scope).get(operation.target.id);
					if (!current || !fields.every((field) => typeof value[field.key] === 'string'))
						return { status: 'failure', message: text('saveDenied') };
					const next: ApplicationRecord = {
						...current,
						title: String(value.title).trim(),
						description: String(value.description),
						owner:
							String(value.owner) === String(current.owner ?? '')
								? current.owner
								: String(value.owner),
						version: String(value.version) || null,
						platforms: String(value.platforms)
							.split('\n')
							.map((item) => item.trim())
							.filter(Boolean)
					};
					store(context.scope).set(current.id, next);
					displayRows(context.scope).set(current.id, {
						...displayRows(context.scope).get(current.id),
						updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
					});
					audit.commits++;
					const result: AsamSaveResult = { status: 'success', data: { id: current.id } };
					operations.set(key, { id: current.id, result });
					return mode === 'unknown-applied'
						? { status: 'unknown', message: text('saveUnknown') }
						: result;
				},
				async verify(operation, context) {
					audit.verifies++;
					await wait(context.signal);
					const original = operations.get(
						JSON.stringify([operation.scope, operation.target.operationId])
					);
					return original
						? { status: 'success', data: { id: original.id } }
						: { status: 'unknown' };
				},
				confirmDiscard: () =>
					AsamMessageBox.confirm(text('discard'), text('editTitle'), {
						confirmButtonText: text('confirm'),
						cancelButtonText: text('cancel')
					}).then(
						() => true,
						() => false
					),
				onSaved: () => {
					saved.value = true;
					void session.read(() => session.controller.refresh());
					if (workflow.detail.active.value) void workflow.detail.refresh();
				}
			}
		});
		const host: ApplicationHost = {
			session,
			workflow,
			presentation: (key) => displayRows(session.runtime.scope).get(key)
		};
		return { session, workflow, host };
	})!;
	let version = 1,
		disposed = false;
	async function rebind() {
		saved.value = false;
		access.version = String(++version);
		owned.session.runtime.setScope(
			JSON.stringify(['application-demo', access.identity, access.version])
		);
		owned.session.controller.resumeScope({ ...emptyConditions });
		if (!access.disabled && access.permitted)
			await owned.session.read(() => owned.session.controller.submit());
	}
	return {
		host: owned.host,
		controls,
		access,
		saved,
		audit,
		async initialize() {
			await owned.session.read(() => owned.session.controller.submit());
		},
		async identity() {
			access.identity =
				access.identity === 'application-reader-a'
					? 'application-reader-b'
					: 'application-reader-a';
			await rebind();
		},
		toggleReadonly() {
			access.readonly = !access.readonly;
		},
		async toggleDisabled() {
			access.disabled = !access.disabled;
			await rebind();
		},
		async toggleDenied() {
			access.permitted = !access.permitted;
			await rebind();
		},
		failNext() {
			controls.failNext = true;
		},
		setSaveMode(value: ApplicationSaveMode) {
			controls.save = value;
		},
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			owned.workflow.dispose();
			owned.session.dispose();
			scope.stop();
			textScope.dispose();
		}
	};
}
export type ApplicationFixture = ReturnType<typeof createApplicationFixture>;

ts
export function isApplicationCount(value: unknown): value is number {
	return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;
}

export function applicationCount(value: unknown, locale: string, unknownText: string): string {
	return isApplicationCount(value) ? new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(value) : unknownText;
}

import type { AsamRowKey } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { SearchRecord, SearchSession } from '../Types.js';

/** Supplied display data; counts are never inferred from IDs, loaded rows or the total. */

ts
import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
import { createApplicationFixture } from './Fixture.js';

export async function mountApplicationSearch(
	element: Element,
	host?: { i18n?: AsamI18n; inheritAppearance?: boolean },
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void
) {
	const locale = shallowRef<'zh-CN' | 'en'>('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const fixture = createApplicationFixture(i18n);
	const app = createApp(App, {
		fixture,
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		onLocale: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'application-search-demo' });

	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	try {
		await fixture.initialize();
		app.mount(element);
	} catch (error) {
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
		throw error;
	}
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
import { Bottom, Refresh, Sort, Top } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import type { ListToolbarTool } from '../../shared/ListToolbarTypes.js';
import type { SearchSession } from '../Types.js';

const modes = [
	{ sort: null, label: 'defaultSort', icon: Sort },
	{ sort: { field: 'title', order: 'ascending' }, label: 'titleAsc', icon: Top },
	{ sort: { field: 'title', order: 'descending' }, label: 'titleDesc', icon: Bottom }
] as const;

type SortLabel = (typeof modes)[number]['label'];

export function useSearchListTools(
	session: SearchSession,
	sortLabel: (key: SortLabel) => string,
	refreshLabel: () => string,
	{ refreshFromStart = false } = {}
) {
	const c = session.controller;
	const canQuery = computed(() => {
		const access = session.access();
		return access.permitted && !access.disabled && c.scopeReady.value;
	});
	const canRead = computed(() => canQuery.value && !c.page.loading.value);
	const sortIndex = computed(() => {
		const sort = c.intent.value?.sort;
		return Math.max(
			0,
			modes.findIndex(
				({ sort: mode }) => mode?.field === sort?.field && mode?.order === sort?.order
			)
		);
	});
	const tools = computed<readonly ListToolbarTool[]>(() => {
		const mode = modes[sortIndex.value] ?? modes[0];
		return [
			{
				id: 'sort',
				label: sortLabel(mode.label),
				icon: mode.icon,
				disabled: !canQuery.value || !c.intent.value,
				ariaDisabled: canQuery.value && !canRead.value,
				pressed: sortIndex.value !== 0,
				state: sortIndex.value === 0 ? 'default-sort' : undefined
			},
			{ id: 'refresh', label: refreshLabel(), icon: Refresh, disabled: !canRead.value }
		];
	});
	function run(id: string) {
		if (!canRead.value) return;
		if (id === 'sort' && c.intent.value) {
			const next = modes[(sortIndex.value + 1) % modes.length] ?? modes[0];
			void session.read(() => c.setSort(next.sort));
		}
		if (id === 'refresh') {
			const intent = c.intent.value;
			void session.read(() =>
				refreshFromStart && intent && intent.currentPage > 1
					? c.setSort(intent.sort)
					: c.refresh()
			);
		}
	}
	return { tools, run };
}

	<AsamFormDialog
		v-if="workflow.editor"
		:controller="workflow.editor"
		:title="editTitle"
		:field-labels="fieldLabels"
		:size="size"

		class="asam-crud-detail-overlay"
		:controller="workflow.detail"

		:field-labels="fieldLabels"

			><AsamButton
				v-if="workflow.editor"
				type="primary"
				:disabled="!workflow.canEdit.value"
				@click="workflow.edit()"

			><AsamButton @click="workflow.close()" type="primary">{{

			}}</AsamButton></template

} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamDataRuntime, AsamRowKey } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface RecordWorkflowOptions<Row extends object> {
	runtime: AsamDataRuntime;
	fields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[];
	key: (row: Row) => AsamRowKey;
	resolve: (key: AsamRowKey) => Row | undefined;
	context: () => string;
	allowed: (action: 'detail' | 'edit', row: Row) => boolean;
	detail: (row: Row) => AsamDetailSource;
	editor?: Omit<AsamEditorConfig, 'runtime' | 'fields' | 'canWrite'>;
	operationId: (row: Row) => string;
	create?: { allowed: () => boolean; operationId: () => string };
}
/** Shared page composition of the original editor/detail protocols, with no write state machine. */
export function useRecordWorkflow<Row extends object>(options: RecordWorkflowOptions<Row>) {
	const activeKey = shallowRef<AsamRowKey>();
	const creating = shallowRef(false);
	const detail = useAsamDetail({ runtime: options.runtime, fields: options.fields });
	const selected = computed(() =>
		activeKey.value === undefined ? undefined : options.resolve(activeKey.value)
	);
	const canEdit = computed(
		() => !!options.editor && !!selected.value && options.allowed('edit', selected.value)
	);
	const editor = options.editor
		? useAsamEditor({
				...options.editor,
				runtime: options.runtime,
				fields: options.fields,
				canWrite: () =>
					creating.value ? options.create?.allowed() === true : canEdit.value
			})
		: undefined;
	const stop = watch(
		options.context,
		() => {
			activeKey.value = undefined;
			creating.value = false;
			editor?.invalidate();
			detail.close();
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	function canonical(row: Row, action: 'detail' | 'edit') {
		const current = options.resolve(options.key(row));
		return current && options.allowed(action, current) ? current : undefined;
	}
	return {
		detail,
		editor,
		canEdit,
		creating,
		async create() {
			if (!editor || !options.create?.allowed()) return;
			creating.value = true;
			activeKey.value = undefined;
			await editor.open({ mode: 'create', operationId: options.create.operationId() });
		},
		async show(row: Row) {
			const current = canonical(row, 'detail');
			if (!current) return;
			activeKey.value = options.key(current);
			await detail.open(options.detail(current));
		},
		async edit(row?: Row) {
			const current = row ? canonical(row, 'edit') : selected.value;
			if (!current || !editor || !options.allowed('edit', current)) return;
			creating.value = false;
			activeKey.value = options.key(current);
			await editor.open({
				mode: 'edit',
				id: activeKey.value,
				operationId: options.operationId(current)
			});
		},
		close() {
			detail.close();
		},
		dispose() {
			stop();
			editor?.dispose();
			detail.dispose();
			activeKey.value = undefined;
		}
	};
}
export interface RecordOverlayView {
	readonly detail: AsamDetailController;
	readonly editor?: AsamEditorController;
	readonly canEdit: ComputedRef<boolean>;
	edit(): Promise<void>;
	close(): void;
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type { AsamCardLayout, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { FullScreen, Grid, List, Plus, ScaleToOriginal } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import type { ListToolbarTool } from './ListToolbarTypes.js';

const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<{
		label: string;
		summary?: string;
		size?: AsamControlSize;
		createLabel?: string;
		createDisabled?: boolean;
		tools?: readonly ListToolbarTool[];
		viewDisabled?: boolean;
		wide?: boolean;
		layout?: AsamCardLayout;
	}>(),
	{ wide: undefined }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{
	create: [];
	action: [id: string];
	'update:wide': [wide: boolean];
	'update:layout': [layout: AsamCardLayout];
}>();
const i18n = useAsamProI18n();
const labels = computed(() =>
	i18n.locale.value.startsWith('en')
		? {
				shrink: 'Use constrained width',
				widen: 'Use full width',
				horizontal: 'Switch to horizontal layout',
				vertical: 'Switch to vertical layout'
			}
		: {
				shrink: '切为窄版',
				widen: '铺满内容区',
				horizontal: '切为横向排列',
				vertical: '切为纵向排列'
			}
);
const actions = computed<readonly ListToolbarTool[]>(() => {
	const items = [...(props.tools ?? [])];
	if (props.wide !== undefined) {
		items.push({
			id: 'width',
			label: props.wide ? labels.value.shrink : labels.value.widen,
			icon: props.wide ? ScaleToOriginal : FullScreen,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: props.wide
		});
	}
	if (props.layout) {
		const vertical = props.layout === 'list';
		items.push({
			id: 'layout',
			label: vertical ? labels.value.horizontal : labels.value.vertical,
			icon: vertical ? Grid : List,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: vertical
		});
	}
	return items;
});
function activate(tool: ListToolbarTool) {
	if (tool.disabled || tool.ariaDisabled) return;
	if (tool.id === 'width' && props.wide !== undefined) emit('update:wide', !props.wide);
	else if (tool.id === 'layout' && props.layout)
		emit('update:layout', props.layout === 'list' ? 'grid' : 'list');
	else emit('action', tool.id);
}
</script>

export function displayValue(value, scope) {
	return value === undefined
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.notProvided')
			: '未提供'
		: value === null
			? scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.search.unknown')
				: '未知'
			: value === false
				? scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.search.no')
					: '否'
				: value === true
					? scope?.enabled.value
						? scope.t('app.templates.search.yes')
						: '是'
					: String(value);
}
export function displayDate(value, scope) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) return displayValue(value, scope);
	return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) &&
		Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) &&
		new Date(value).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(scope.locale.value, {
					year: 'numeric',
					month: '2-digit',
					day: '2-digit',
					timeZone: 'UTC'
				}).format(new Date(value))
			: value
		: scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.invalidDate')
			: '日期无效';
}
export function displayProgress(value, scope) {
	return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 100
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? new Intl.NumberFormat(scope.locale.value, {
					style: 'percent',
					maximumFractionDigits: 20
				}).format(value / 100)
			: `${value}%`
		: scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.unknownProgress')
			: '进度未知';
}

			},
			{

import { computed } from 'vue';
export function createSearchQueryController(session, view) {
	const controller = session.controller;
	const ready = computed(
		() =>
			!session.access().disabled && session.access().permitted && controller.scopeReady.value
	);
	function guarded(action) {
		return async (validate) => {
			if (!ready.value) return { status: 'blocked' };
			let result = { status: 'blocked' };
			const current = await session.read(async () => {
				view.beforeRead?.();
				result = await action(validate);
			});
			return current ? result : { status: 'cancelled' };
		};
	}
	return {
		...controller,
		fields: computed(view.fields),
		draft: computed(() => view.encode?.(controller.draft.value) ?? controller.draft.value),
		scopeReady: ready,
		setDraft(draft) {
			if (ready.value) controller.setDraft(view.decode?.(draft) ?? draft);
		},
		submit: guarded(controller.submit),
		reset: guarded(view.reset ?? controller.reset)
	};
}
export function keywordQueryField(label, name, placeholder) {
	return {
		key: 'keyword',
		kind: 'text',
		label,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { name, placeholder, clearable: true } } }
	};
}

					author: index % 2 ? '陈澄' : '许知',
					publishedAt: index % 3 ? '2026-10-10' : null,
					tags: ['设计方法', index % 2 ? '案例' : '实践'],
					body: [
						'从一个具体问题开始，记录观察、约束与取舍。',
						'示例正文仅为本地合成文本。<script>不会执行</script>',
						base.description
					]
				};
			case 'projects':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					stage: index % 4 ? '宿主阶段：研究验证' : undefined,
					progress: index % 4 ? (index * 7) % 101 : NaN,
					startDate: '2026-09-01',
					endDate: index % 3 ? '2026-12-01' : null,
					members: [
						{ name: '林岚', avatar: index === 2 ? './missing-avatar.svg' : undefined },
						{ name: '周远' }
					]
				};
			case 'applications':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					icon: localGraphic,
					version: index % 3 ? '2.1.0' : null,
					platforms: ['Web', '桌面浏览器'],
					available: index % 3 ? true : false,
					route: 'local-demo'
				};
		}
	});
}
export function querySearchRecords(rows, request) {
	const q = request.query;
	const keyword = typeof q.keyword === 'string' ? q.keyword.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() : '';
	const filtered = rows.filter(
		(row) =>
			(!keyword ||
				`${row.title} ${row.description} ${row.kind === 'articles' ? row.body.join(' ') : ''}`
					.toLocaleLowerCase()
					.includes(keyword)) &&
			['category', 'status', 'owner'].every(
				(key) =>
					q[key] === undefined ||
					Object.is(
						key === 'status' && row.kind === 'applications'
							? row.available
							: Reflect.get(row, key),
						q[key]
					)
			)
	);
	if (request.sort) {
		const { field, order } = request.sort;
		if (!['title', 'id'].includes(field))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				new TypeError('未允许的排序字段'),
				'app.templates.search.invalidSort'
			);
		filtered.sort(
			(a, b) =>
				String(Reflect.get(a, field)).localeCompare(
					String(Reflect.get(b, field)),
					'zh-CN',
					{ numeric: true }
				) * (order === 'ascending' ? 1 : -1) ||
				encodeRowKey(a.id).localeCompare(encodeRowKey(b.id))
		);
	}
	return {
		list: filtered.slice(
			(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
			request.currentPage * request.pageSize
		),
		total: filtered.length
	};
}
/** 这是可替换的合成读取适配，查询/排序作用于全部100条。 */
export function createSearchService(kind) {
	const rows = createSearchRecords(kind);
	let fail = false,
		calls = 0;
	return {
		get calls() {
			return calls;
		},
		failNext() {
			fail = true;
		},
		async read(request, context) {
			calls++;
			const shouldFail = fail;
			fail = false;
			await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(new DOMException('读取取消', 'AbortError'));
				};
				const timer = setTimeout(() => {
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				}, 100);
				if (context.signal.aborted) abort();
				else context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
			});
			if (shouldFail)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'合成读取失败，请重试',
					'app.templates.search.readFailed'
				);
			return querySearchRecords(rows, request);
		}
	};
}

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { effectScope, toValue } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { emptyConditions } from './Types.js';
import { searchContent } from './Content.js';
export const searchFields = [
	{ key: 'keyword', label: '关键词', kind: 'text', defaultValue: () => '' },
	...['category', 'status', 'owner'].map((key) => ({
		key,
		label: { category: '类别', status: '状态', owner: '负责人' }[key] ?? key,
		kind: 'single',
		query: (value) => value
	}))
];
/** 自有effect scope只释放本会话创建的controller；借入runtime/controller从不dispose。 */
export function createSearchSession(options) {
	if (options.controller && !options.runtime)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('借入controller必须显式提供其宿主runtime'),
			'app.templates.search.borrowRuntime'
		);
	const scope = effectScope(true);
	const runtime =
		options.runtime ??
		createAsamDataRuntime({
			scope: `search:${options.kind}:${toValue(options.access).identity}`
		});
	let alive = true;
	const access = () => toValue(options.access);
	const guard = () =>
		JSON.stringify([
			runtime.scope,
			runtime.epoch,
			access().identity,
			access().version,
			access().disabled,
			access().permitted
		]);
	const current = (token) =>
		alive && !access().disabled && access().permitted && token === guard();
	const accumulatesPages = !!options.accumulatePages && !options.controller;
	const prefixes = new Map();
	const queryKey = (query) => JSON.stringify([query.query, query.sort, query.pageSize]);
	const controller =
		options.controller ??
		scope.run(() =>
			useAsamListController({
				fields: searchFields,
				initial: { ...emptyConditions },
				pageSize: 20,
				immediate: false,
				rowKey: (row) => row.id,
				runtime,
				api: async (request, context) => {
					const token = guard();
					if (!current(token))
						throw createAsamMessageError(
							'当前身份、权限或禁用状态不允许读取',
							'app.templates.search.readDenied'
						);
					let prefix = [];
					if (accumulatesPages) {
						const previous = controller.successfulSource.value;
						if (request.currentPage === 1) prefixes.clear();
						else if (
							previous?.epoch === runtime.epoch &&
							queryKey(previous) === queryKey(request)
						) {
							if (previous.currentPage + 1 === request.currentPage) {
								prefix = controller.page.data.value.list;
								prefixes.set(request.currentPage, prefix);
							} else if (previous.currentPage >= request.currentPage) {
								prefix = prefixes.get(request.currentPage) ?? [];
							}
						}
					}
					const result = await options.service.read(request, context);
					context.signal.throwIfAborted();
					if (!current(token)) throw new DOMException('读取上下文已失效', 'AbortError');
					if (!accumulatesPages || !result.total) return result;
					const records = new Map(
						[...prefix, ...result.list].map((row) => [row.id, row])
					);
					return {
						list: [...records.values()].slice(0, result.total),
						total: result.total
					};
				}
			})
		);
	return {
		kind: options.kind,
		accumulatesPages,
		controller,
		runtime,
		content: searchContent,
		access,
		guard,
		current,
		async read(operation) {
			const token = guard();
			if (!current(token)) return false;
			await operation();
			return current(token);
		},
		dispose() {
			if (!alive) return;
			alive = false;
			scope.stop();
		}
	};
}

export const searchKinds = ['basic', 'cards', 'articles', 'projects', 'applications'];
export const searchTitles = {
	basic: '资料列表',
	cards: '灵感卡片',
	articles: '文章搜索',
	projects: '项目搜索',
	applications: '应用搜索'
};
export const emptyConditions = {
	keyword: '',
	category: undefined,
	status: undefined,
	owner: undefined
};
export function encodeRowKey(key) {
	return `${typeof key}:${String(key)}`;
}
export function displaySearchTitle(kind, scope) {
	const keys = {
		basic: 'app.templates.search.titleBasic',
		cards: 'app.templates.search.titleCards',
		articles: 'app.templates.search.titleArticles',
		projects: 'app.templates.search.titleProjects',
		applications: 'app.templates.search.titleApplications'
	};
	return scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t(keys[kind]) : searchTitles[kind];
}

	{ label: 'engineering', value: '工程' }
];
const wide = shallowRef(false);
const layout = computed({
	get: () => presentation.value.layout,
	set(value) {
		presentation.value = { ...presentation.value, layout: value };
	}
});
const { tools, run: runTool } = useSearchListTools(
	props.host.session,
	(key) => t(key),
	() => i18n.t('pro.table.editing.refresh')
);
const fieldLabels = computed(() => ({
	title: t('fieldTitle'),
	description: t('description'),
	owner: t('owner'),
	version: t('version'),
	platforms: t('platforms')
}));
const content = (row) => ({
	title: row.title,
	description: row.description
});
const count = (value) => applicationCount(value, i18n.locale.value, t('unknown'));
async function search() {
	if (!blocked.value) await props.host.session.read(() => c.submit());
}
async function setCategory(value) {
	if (blocked.value) return;
	c.setDraft({ ...c.draft.value, category: value });
	await search();
}
async function setAvailability(value) {
	if (
		blocked.value ||
		typeof value !== 'string' ||
		!['all', 'available', 'unavailable', 'unknown'].includes(value)
	)
		return;
	c.setDraft({
		...c.draft.value,
		status:
			value === 'available'
				? true
				: value === 'unavailable'
					? false
					: value === 'unknown'
						? null
						: undefined
	});
	await search();
}
async function resume() {
	if (blocked.value) return;
	c.resumeScope({ ...emptyConditions });
	await search();
}
</script>

import { effectScope, reactive, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createAsamWriteCoordinator } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { applicationMessages } from './I18n.js';
import { createSearchSession } from '../Session.js';
import { createSearchRecords, querySearchRecords } from '../Service.js';
import { emptyConditions } from '../Types.js';
import { useRecordWorkflow } from '../shared/RecordWorkflow.js';
export const applicationSaveModes = ['success', 'failure', 'unknown-applied'];
/** Explicit local demo records and metrics, adapted into the original controllers. */
export function createApplicationFixture(i18n) {
	const scope = effectScope(true);
	const textScope = extendAsamI18n(i18n, applicationMessages);
	const access = reactive({
		identity: 'application-reader-a',
		version: '1',
		disabled: false,
		readonly: false,
		permitted: true
	});
	const controls = reactive({ save: 'success', failNext: false });
	const saved = shallowRef(false);
	const audit = { reads: 0, saves: 0, commits: 0, verifies: 0 };
	const seed = createSearchRecords('applications')
		.filter((row) => row.kind === 'applications')
		.slice(0, 25)
		.map((row, index) => ({
			...row,
			available: index === 0 ? null : index === 1 ? false : row.available,
			icon: index === 2 ? 'data:image/png;base64,AAAA' : row.icon
		}));
	const stores = new Map();
	const operations = new Map();
	const seedDisplay = new Map(
		seed.map((row, index) => [
			row.id,
			{
				activeUsers: index === 0 ? 0 : index === 1 ? null : 1280 + index * 37,
				weeklyNew: index === 0 ? 0 : index === 1 ? null : 20 + index * 3,
				updatedAt: index === 0 ? null : '2026-10-30'
			}
		])
	);
	const displayStores = new Map();
	const text = (key) => textScope.t(...[`app.templates.applicationSearch.${key}`]);
	function store(owner) {
		let value = stores.get(owner);
		if (!value) {
			value = new Map(seed.map((row) => [row.id, { ...row, platforms: [...row.platforms] }]));
			stores.set(owner, value);
		}
		return value;
	}
	function displayRows(owner) {
		let value = displayStores.get(owner);
		if (!value) {
			value = new Map(seedDisplay);
			displayStores.set(owner, value);
		}
		return value;
	}
	async function wait(signal) {
		await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			const abort = () => {
				clearTimeout(timer);
				signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
				reject(new DOMException('Read cancelled', 'AbortError'));
			};
			const timer = setTimeout(() => {
				signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
				resolve();
			}, 80);
			if (signal.aborted) abort();
			else signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		});
	}
	function model(row) {
		return {
			title: row.title,
			description: row.description,
			owner: String(row.owner ?? ''),
			version: row.version ?? '',
			platforms: row.platforms.join('\n')
		};
	}
	const fields = [
		{ key: 'title', label: '应用标题', kind: 'text' },
		{ key: 'owner', label: '负责人', kind: 'text' },
		{ key: 'description', label: '摘要', kind: 'textarea' },
		{ key: 'version', label: '版本', kind: 'text' },
		{ key: 'platforms', label: '平台（每行一个）', kind: 'textarea' }
	];
	let session;
	const service = {
		async read(request, context) {
			audit.reads++;
			const owner = session.runtime.scope;
			await wait(context.signal);
			if (controls.failNext) {
				controls.failNext = false;
				throw new Error(text('readError'));
			}
			return querySearchRecords([...store(owner).values()], request);
		}
	};
	const owned = scope.run(() => {
		session = createSearchSession({ kind: 'applications', service, access: () => access });
		const allowed = (action, row) =>
			row.kind === 'applications' &&
			session.current(session.guard()) &&
			session.controller.resultReady.value &&
			(action === 'detail' || !access.readonly);
		const writes = createAsamWriteCoordinator();
		const operationIds = new Map();
		let sequence = 0;
		const workflow = useRecordWorkflow({
			runtime: session.runtime,
			fields,
			key: (row) => row.id,
			resolve: (key) => session.controller.page.data.value.list.find((row) => row.id === key),
			context: () =>
				JSON.stringify([
					session.guard(),
					session.controller.intent.value?.query,
					session.controller.intent.value?.sort
				]),
			allowed,
			detail: (row) => ({
				mode: 'load',
				id: row.id,
				load: async (id, context) => {
					await wait(context.signal);
					const current = store(context.scope).get(id);
					return current
						? { status: 'ready', data: model(current) }
						: { status: 'missing' };
				}
			}),
			operationId: (row) => {
				saved.value = false;
				const key = JSON.stringify([session.runtime.scope, typeof row.id, row.id]);
				const previous = operationIds.get(key);
				const status = previous
					? writes.get(session.runtime.scope, previous)?.status
					: undefined;
				if (previous && (status === 'saving' || status === 'unknown')) return previous;
				const next = `application-edit-${++sequence}`;
				operationIds.set(key, next);
				return next;
			},
			editor: {
				coordinator: writes,
				load: async (target, context) => {
					await wait(context.signal);
					const row =
						target.id === undefined ? undefined : store(context.scope).get(target.id);
					if (!row) throw new Error('Application missing');
					return model(row);
				},
				validatePayload: async (value) =>
					typeof value.title === 'string' && value.title.trim()
						? []
						: [{ key: 'title', message: text('required') }],
				formatError: (cause) => {
					if (cause && typeof cause === 'object' && 'status' in cause) {
						if (cause.status === 'unknown') return text('saveUnknown');
						if (cause.status === 'failure') return text('saveDenied');
					}
					return text('operationError');
				},
				async save(value, operation, context) {
					audit.saves++;
					const mode = controls.save;
					const key = JSON.stringify([operation.scope, operation.target.operationId]);
					const prior = operations.get(key);
					if (prior) return prior.result;
					await wait(context.signal);
					if (mode === 'failure')
						return { status: 'failure', message: text('saveDenied') };
					const current =
						operation.target.id === undefined
							? undefined
							: store(context.scope).get(operation.target.id);
					if (!current || !fields.every((field) => typeof value[field.key] === 'string'))
						return { status: 'failure', message: text('saveDenied') };
					const next = {
						...current,
						title: String(value.title).trim(),
						description: String(value.description),
						owner:
							String(value.owner) === String(current.owner ?? '')
								? current.owner
								: String(value.owner),
						version: String(value.version) || null,
						platforms: String(value.platforms)
							.split('\n')
							.map((item) => item.trim())
							.filter(Boolean)
					};
					store(context.scope).set(current.id, next);
					displayRows(context.scope).set(current.id, {
						...displayRows(context.scope).get(current.id),
						updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
					});
					audit.commits++;
					const result = { status: 'success', data: { id: current.id } };
					operations.set(key, { id: current.id, result });
					return mode === 'unknown-applied'
						? { status: 'unknown', message: text('saveUnknown') }
						: result;
				},
				async verify(operation, context) {
					audit.verifies++;
					await wait(context.signal);
					const original = operations.get(
						JSON.stringify([operation.scope, operation.target.operationId])
					);
					return original
						? { status: 'success', data: { id: original.id } }
						: { status: 'unknown' };
				},
				confirmDiscard: () =>
					AsamMessageBox.confirm(text('discard'), text('editTitle'), {
						confirmButtonText: text('confirm'),
						cancelButtonText: text('cancel')
					}).then(
						() => true,
						() => false
					),
				onSaved: () => {
					saved.value = true;
					void session.read(() => session.controller.refresh());
					if (workflow.detail.active.value) void workflow.detail.refresh();
				}
			}
		});
		const host = {
			session,
			workflow,
			presentation: (key) => displayRows(session.runtime.scope).get(key)
		};
		return { session, workflow, host };
	});
	let version = 1,
		disposed = false;
	async function rebind() {
		saved.value = false;
		access.version = String(++version);
		owned.session.runtime.setScope(
			JSON.stringify(['application-demo', access.identity, access.version])
		);
		owned.session.controller.resumeScope({ ...emptyConditions });
		if (!access.disabled && access.permitted)
			await owned.session.read(() => owned.session.controller.submit());
	}
	return {
		host: owned.host,
		controls,
		access,
		saved,
		audit,
		async initialize() {
			await owned.session.read(() => owned.session.controller.submit());
		},
		async identity() {
			access.identity =
				access.identity === 'application-reader-a'
					? 'application-reader-b'
					: 'application-reader-a';
			await rebind();
		},
		toggleReadonly() {
			access.readonly = !access.readonly;
		},
		async toggleDisabled() {
			access.disabled = !access.disabled;
			await rebind();
		},
		async toggleDenied() {
			access.permitted = !access.permitted;
			await rebind();
		},
		failNext() {
			controls.failNext = true;
		},
		setSaveMode(value) {
			controls.save = value;
		},
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			owned.workflow.dispose();
			owned.session.dispose();
			scope.stop();
			textScope.dispose();
		}
	};
}

export function isApplicationCount(value) {
	return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0;
}
export function applicationCount(value, locale, unknownText) {
	return isApplicationCount(value) ? new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(value) : unknownText;
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
import { createApplicationFixture } from './Fixture.js';
export async function mountApplicationSearch(element, host, onError) {
	const locale = shallowRef('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const fixture = createApplicationFixture(i18n);
	const app = createApp(App, {
		fixture,
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		onLocale: (value) => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'application-search-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	try {
		await fixture.initialize();
		app.mount(element);
	} catch (error) {
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
		throw error;
	}
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
import { Bottom, Refresh, Sort, Top } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
const modes = [
	{ sort: null, label: 'defaultSort', icon: Sort },
	{ sort: { field: 'title', order: 'ascending' }, label: 'titleAsc', icon: Top },
	{ sort: { field: 'title', order: 'descending' }, label: 'titleDesc', icon: Bottom }
];
export function useSearchListTools(
	session,
	sortLabel,
	refreshLabel,
	{ refreshFromStart = false } = {}
) {
	const c = session.controller;
	const canQuery = computed(() => {
		const access = session.access();
		return access.permitted && !access.disabled && c.scopeReady.value;
	});
	const canRead = computed(() => canQuery.value && !c.page.loading.value);
	const sortIndex = computed(() => {
		const sort = c.intent.value?.sort;
		return Math.max(
			0,
			modes.findIndex(
				({ sort: mode }) => mode?.field === sort?.field && mode?.order === sort?.order
			)
		);
	});
	const tools = computed(() => {
		const mode = modes[sortIndex.value] ?? modes[0];
		return [
			{
				id: 'sort',
				label: sortLabel(mode.label),
				icon: mode.icon,
				disabled: !canQuery.value || !c.intent.value,
				ariaDisabled: canQuery.value && !canRead.value,
				pressed: sortIndex.value !== 0,
				state: sortIndex.value === 0 ? 'default-sort' : undefined
			},
			{ id: 'refresh', label: refreshLabel(), icon: Refresh, disabled: !canRead.value }
		];
	});
	function run(id) {
		if (!canRead.value) return;
		if (id === 'sort' && c.intent.value) {
			const next = modes[(sortIndex.value + 1) % modes.length] ?? modes[0];
			void session.read(() => c.setSort(next.sort));
		}
		if (id === 'refresh') {
			const intent = c.intent.value;
			void session.read(() =>
				refreshFromStart && intent && intent.currentPage > 1
					? c.setSort(intent.sort)
					: c.refresh()
			);
		}
	}
	return { tools, run };
}

import { computed, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { useAsamEditor, useAsamDetail } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
/** Shared page composition of the original editor/detail protocols, with no write state machine. */
export function useRecordWorkflow(options) {
	const activeKey = shallowRef();
	const creating = shallowRef(false);
	const detail = useAsamDetail({ runtime: options.runtime, fields: options.fields });
	const selected = computed(() =>
		activeKey.value === undefined ? undefined : options.resolve(activeKey.value)
	);
	const canEdit = computed(
		() => !!options.editor && !!selected.value && options.allowed('edit', selected.value)
	);
	const editor = options.editor
		? useAsamEditor({
				...options.editor,
				runtime: options.runtime,
				fields: options.fields,
				canWrite: () =>
					creating.value ? options.create?.allowed() === true : canEdit.value
			})
		: undefined;
	const stop = watch(
		options.context,
		() => {
			activeKey.value = undefined;
			creating.value = false;
			editor?.invalidate();
			detail.close();
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	function canonical(row, action) {
		const current = options.resolve(options.key(row));
		return current && options.allowed(action, current) ? current : undefined;
	}
	return {
		detail,
		editor,
		canEdit,
		creating,
		async create() {
			if (!editor || !options.create?.allowed()) return;
			creating.value = true;
			activeKey.value = undefined;
			await editor.open({ mode: 'create', operationId: options.create.operationId() });
		},
		async show(row) {
			const current = canonical(row, 'detail');
			if (!current) return;
			activeKey.value = options.key(current);
			await detail.open(options.detail(current));
		},
		async edit(row) {
			const current = row ? canonical(row, 'edit') : selected.value;
			if (!current || !editor || !options.allowed('edit', current)) return;
			creating.value = false;
			activeKey.value = options.key(current);
			await editor.open({
				mode: 'edit',
				id: activeKey.value,
				operationId: options.operationId(current)
			});
		},
		close() {
			detail.close();
		},
		dispose() {
			stop();
			editor?.dispose();
			detail.dispose();
			activeKey.value = undefined;
		}
	};
}

<template>
	<div class="template-list-toolbar" role="toolbar" :aria-label="label">
		<div class="template-list-toolbar-start">
			<AsamButton
				v-if="createLabel"
				type="primary"
				:size="size"
				:icon="Plus"
				:disabled="createDisabled"
				@click="emit('create')"
				>{{ createLabel }}</AsamButton
			><span v-if="summary" class="template-list-toolbar-summary" role="status">{{
				summary
			}}</span>
		</div>
		<div v-if="actions.length" class="template-list-toolbar-tools">
			<AsamButton
				v-for="tool in actions"
				:key="tool.id"
				class="template-list-toolbar-icon"
				type="primary"
				:text="!tool.pressed"
				:size="size"
				:icon="tool.icon"
				:disabled="tool.disabled"
				:aria-disabled="tool.ariaDisabled || undefined"
				:aria-pressed="tool.pressed"
				:aria-label="tool.label"
				:title="tool.label"
				:data-state="tool.state"
				@click="activate(tool)"
			/>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { FullScreen, Grid, List, Plus, ScaleToOriginal } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
const props = defineProps({
	label: { type: String, required: true },
	summary: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	createLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	createDisabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	tools: { type: Array, required: false },
	viewDisabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	wide: { type: Boolean, required: false, default: undefined },
	layout: { type: String, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['create', 'action', 'update:wide', 'update:layout']);
const i18n = useAsamProI18n();
const labels = computed(() =>
	i18n.locale.value.startsWith('en')
		? {
				shrink: 'Use constrained width',
				widen: 'Use full width',
				horizontal: 'Switch to horizontal layout',
				vertical: 'Switch to vertical layout'
			}
		: {
				shrink: '切为窄版',
				widen: '铺满内容区',
				horizontal: '切为横向排列',
				vertical: '切为纵向排列'
			}
);
const actions = computed(() => {
	const items = [...(props.tools ?? [])];
	if (props.wide !== undefined) {
		items.push({
			id: 'width',
			label: props.wide ? labels.value.shrink : labels.value.widen,
			icon: props.wide ? ScaleToOriginal : FullScreen,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: props.wide
		});
	}
	if (props.layout) {
		const vertical = props.layout === 'list';
		items.push({
			id: 'layout',
			label: vertical ? labels.value.horizontal : labels.value.vertical,
			icon: vertical ? Grid : List,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: vertical
		});
	}
	return items;
});
function activate(tool) {
	if (tool.disabled || tool.ariaDisabled) return;
	if (tool.id === 'width' && props.wide !== undefined) emit('update:wide', !props.wide);
	else if (tool.id === 'layout' && props.layout)
		emit('update:layout', props.layout === 'list' ? 'grid' : 'list');
	else emit('action', tool.id);
}
</script>

export {};

应用搜索复用原列表控制器与真实AsamProList/CardGroup，展示图标、摘要、活跃用户、本周新增、可用性、负责人和显式更新时间。计数仅取宿主投影，0保留，缺失、无效或非有限计数显示未提供；不从记录索引或已加载数量推断真实业务统计。

详情与管理

标题与独立按钮打开 CRUD 的 AsamDetailDrawer；管理使用同源RecordWorkflow与原AsamFormDialog/Editor协议，编辑标题、摘要、负责人、版本与平台。unknown关闭重开仍核验原operationId，不重发。只读保留详情，身份与权限变化隔离旧数据和弹层；统计、可用性启停和任意外链不伪造写入。

接入与边界

原ApplicationRecord保持，available的true/false/null与通用status分列；四个筛选选项精确映射原status查询。图标失败由真实AsamAvatar回退；页面复用已有auto/grid/masonry、分页、选择和排序。演示仅使用本地合成数据，没有真实后台DTO/API、认证或持久化。TS strict、strictTemplates=true、skipLibCheck=false；JS checkJs=false。
